name: dreambank_raw
source: DreamBank (dreambank.net; Domhoff & Schneider 2008). Compiled CSV with per-dream text, dreamer, emotions, themes.
license: Research use; cite Domhoff & Schneider (2008) and DreamBank; do not re-host raw text.
notes: Per-dream text ('content') with named 'dreamer' + 'description'. CAVEATS: dates are unreliable (free-form, ~72% parseable); 'age' is SERIES-LEVEL (one age per series, ~1 dream/person in the age-labelled subset); includes AGGREGATE/normative collections (Hall/VdC norms, Peruvian/blind/teen groups, baseline survey) that are NOT individuals — excluded via description regex for the biometric (F0013). Used by F0013/F0020/F0021/F0022.
